steps.label: :react: React Native SDK, bare and Expo hosts
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
source scripts/bazel/ci-cache.sh
export DEVELOPER_DIR="$HOME/Applications/Xcode-26.6.app/Contents/Developer"
xcodebuild -version
export JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home
export ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/share/android-commandlinetools}"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"
if [[ ! -x /opt/homebrew/opt/ruby/bin/ruby ]]; then
  HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 brew install ruby
fi
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/ruby/bin:$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
"$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" \
  "platforms;android-36" "build-tools;36.0.0" "ndk;29.0.14206865" \
  "platforms;android-37.0" "build-tools;37.0.0" "ndk;27.1.12297006" \
  "cmake;3.22.1"
corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run prepare:native
corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run build
(cd examples/bare && corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace install --frozen-lockfile)
(cd examples/expo && corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace install --frozen-lockfile)
node scripts/check.mjs
